errors.error_description: Introduced an unintentional latch by not assigning pre_code on all paths of a combinational decision chain, causing pre_code to hold its previous value when no input bits are set.
Used an explicit sensitivity list that omits cfg_inv while it is read inside the block, causing a simulation-synthesis mismatch.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments within the same clocked always block by assigning valid_q with a blocking assignment while other signals use non-blocking.
